correctness.rationale: A selected edge set is qualifying iff every outside edge has a nonempty, pairwise distinct intersection signature with selected incident edges. I independently generated KG(5,2), its 15 line-graph vertices, exhaustively checked every 0..5 subset (4944 total), obtaining no solution below five and exactly 246 minima. Enumerating every 30,135 unordered pair and BFS from each of 246 vertices gave 1470 exchange edges, all eccentricities five, defect 90 and the prescribed histogram. A separately built S5 action reproduced all four orbit sizes, degrees and distance profiles; the 90-pair defect graph decomposed into ten components of size six with all nonisolates degree three. The finite theorem is exhaustive, not extrapolated.
